title.narrative: 220811_START FUND ALERT 673 Mongolia Anticipation of Dzud

description.narrative:
The project aims to reduce vulnerability of households affected by the Dzud condition in 5 provinces: Arkhangai, Uvurkhangai, Khovd, Bayankhongor and Tuv. Within these provinces, Lead Agency (Save the Children) and Partner (World Vision) have selected 18 soums (counties) to target. There are 3 types of responses planned through proposed project:
- Multi-purpose cash transfer: 60 GBP cash will be distributed to each herder household to support critical input for food security, health, emergency communications, and other basic needs, especially for children. Cash also allows for the families to have the flexibility to prioritize and fulfil their own needs.
- Livestock fodder: Each family will receive 200 kg of fodder. Provision of fodder will keep away herders from spending distributed cash to buy fodder, and enable families to meet other basic needs such as food, hygiene and sanitation.
- Hygiene kits for dormitory children: the hygiene kits (13 GBP per kit) will be provided to 630 children staying at 9 rural dormitories to support maintenance of healthy routine and prevent the spread of infectious diseases.
Total budget is 200,000 GBP, of which 100,000 GBP for World Vision. Save the Children UK signed the award letter with SF. WVUK will sign a SGA with StC Japan and the PIA with WVM.
